Outputs
Monthly reports for the 3 months of project M1:
・2024-10.md - Month of October 2024
・2024-11.md - Month of November 2024
・2024-12.md - Month of December 2024

Acceptance Criteria
Reviewers can verify that the reports submitted & linked above contain comprehensive lists of the funded proposer's activities which satisfy these essential ongoing responsibilities for CIP Editors:
・Daily GitHub review: in numbered "Work on pull requests" and "Work on issues"
・Unscheduled activities: at top, under Qualitative Contributions and Community Discussions
・Biweekly CIP Editors' Meeting: at bottom, confirming attendance & co-leadership of the meeting, with links to meeting agendas

Evidence of Completion
Reviewers will note the overall project goals are satisfied by the continuity of reports submitted here, in the project archive also verifiable by the entire Cardano community:
・github.com/rphair/cip-editing

Although neither the Catalyst proposal nor Statement of Milestones require any particular accomplishment for this period, the following unscheduled activities (spontaneous tasks and maintenance tasks) were noteworthy:
(October 2024) Significant rewrite of CIP-0001 reflecting a year's worth of updates to the CIP editing process in practice, including:
・improvements to categories & metadata used for standards classification
・links from bare instructions in the CIP to corresponding subjective, tutorial sections in the CIP Wiki
・treatments of CIP versioning demanded by the developer community
・adaptation of "enlistment" for special working groups to a more decentralised ecosystem

(October 2024) Launching effort to popularise CIP awareness among the Cardano community: with regular Cardano Forum postings, including a "500 stars for the CIP repository" campaign.
